acceptance.given: An invalid-package case is presented to the Toolchain success evaluator.

oracle.expected: The evaluator returns a non-success verdict and records the invalid-package reason.
forbidden: Success is accepted for an invalid-package case.
oracle.observable: The S7 evaluation result contains a non-success verdict attributable to the invalid-package input.

acceptance.then: Run the invalid-package evaluation through the Toolchain replay path and inspect the parsed verdict.

failure_intents.selector_intent: S7 invalid-package case is incorrectly accepted as success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or preserve the S7 executable check that evaluates an invalid-package case and rejects success with an attributable reason.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted-schema change; revert only the evaluator behavior and its focused test.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: S7 test proves invalid-package evaluation cannot terminate with success.

acceptance.given: Stable and Candidate subjects execute each Matrix Case through the Toolchain replay flow.

oracle.expected: Every Matrix Case execution emits evidence naming both its Matrix Case and executed subject.
forbidden: Execution evidence cannot be attributed to its Matrix Case or subject.
oracle.observable: The emitted evidence record contains a Matrix Case identifier and the corresponding Stable or Candidate subject identifier for every execution.

acceptance.then: Execute the matrix cases and inspect each emitted evidence record for Matrix Case and subject attribution.

failure_intents.selector_intent: S2 execution emits evidence missing either the Matrix Case identifier or executed subject identifier.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure each Matrix Case execution records attributable evidence linking the case identifier and executed Stable or Candidate subject.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing evidence fields; revert only attribution additions and focused tests.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix Case execution -> attributable evidence record
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: S2 test proves every executed Matrix Case has evidence identifying its case and subject.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result has reached success and includes a snapshot reference.

oracle.expected: The successful Replay Result records an independently performed snapshot verification, distinct from merely reporting replay success.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result without independent snapshot verification.
oracle.observable: The S10 result contains a successful verdict plus an independent snapshot-verification record bound to the same snapshot.

acceptance.then: Run the successful replay and inspect the result for a separately executed snapshot verification and its binding.

failure_intents.selector_intent: S10 reports replay success without independently verifying the referenced snapshot.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require successful Replay Results to include an independently executed and bound snapshot verification before acceptance.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted-schema change; revert only independent snapshot-verification enforcement and its focused test.

slice_hint.state_transition: successful Replay Result -> independently verified snapshot binding
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: S10 test proves success is accompanied by an independent verification record for the exact snapshot.
